selection.primary_unavailable_reason: No candidate clears Gate D1 conditions 6 and 7 on frozen C3 evidence. governed.outcome_triage: candidate_strategy determines the verifier label with no error on all 150 enumerated coding outcomes, and removing it leaves the identical 2-of-5 pattern on every task, so nothing discriminates; the 64 benchmark cases are 64/64 passed. experience.strategy_selection: zero changeable decisions. experience.correction_ranking is the only balanced candidate at 60/60 but offers 120 eligible samples against a threshold of 200, and the section 3.3 shortfall cap of 50 cannot close that gap.
selection.operator_decision: Option C of the surface audit: declare the primary surface unavailable on frozen C3 evidence and report it as a measured negative result. Options A and B were declined because both required amending or breaching the section 3.3 shortfall cap.

field_allowlist.rule: A field absent from the declared mapping is refused as unknown_field_timing, not permitted by default.
field_allowlist.post_outcome_note: Post-outcome fields remain legitimate as provenance on a stored graph pair. They are refused only in a query projection.

leakage_validator.control_token_authority: cognitive_os.coding.reality_leakage.scan_for_control_leaks, the C3 release authority; not reimplemented

action_policy.status: recorded but not pre-registered, because the surface was rejected
action_policy.invariant: SurfaceActionCostMatrix refuses any matrix in which abstaining or requesting repair costs less than verifying a candidate the verifier would reject. A predictor can therefore never be optimised into an acceptance authority.

secondary_surface_protocol.task: given a failing state, retrieve a verified failed-to-success edit path as advisory repair context
secondary_surface_protocol.relevance_judgment: task and group identity, frozen before any ranking is produced (S21D1-050)
secondary_surface_protocol.group_policy: the query group is excluded from the candidate pool; correction bytes from the query group never reach the graph arm
secondary_surface_protocol.graph_arm_note: No mandatory uplift in D1. A loss to the vector arm is a valid, reportable result that keeps the vector arm for D2 and rejects FGW.

stop_rules: A change to the field allowlist, the group policy, the resource limits or the relevance judgments creates revision 2 and invalidates every result derived from revision 1.
A held-out evaluator that cannot resolve this bundle's hash refuses to read examples.
If fewer than 80 failed-to-success pairs survive source resolution, Gate D1 stays open rather than the threshold moving.
If no bounded arm reaches the usefulness floor, the result is reported and FGW is rejected; the floor is not lowered.

gate_d1_status_after_w1.condition_3: met: the selection artifact is committed before any held-out metric is read
gate_d1_status_after_w1.condition_4: not applicable: no primary label was pre-registered
gate_d1_status_after_w1.condition_5: met: the leakage validator refuses every prohibited field with a stable reason code
gate_d1_status_after_w1.condition_6: OPEN: no surface reaches 200 eligible held-out outcomes
gate_d1_status_after_w1.condition_7: OPEN: no surface reaches 20 changeable advisory decisions
gate_d1_status_after_w1.conditions_8_to_21: unaffected by this decision; the Experience Memory Graph track proceeds in full
